key_highlights: ASX set to open lower following a sharp Wall Street tech rout driven by AI valuation concerns.
Domestic markets on edge ahead of the pivotal Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) cash rate decision.
Australian home values drop for a seventh consecutive month alongside multi-year low auction clearances.
Coles suffers heavy valuation losses as Woolworths aggressively captures market share.
Rising sovereign borrowing costs and state debt burdens escalate pressure on bond yields.

sectors.trend: Global tech and AI sell-off drives cautious sentiment across ASX growth and tech names.
sectors.implications: Multiple compression risk for high-P/E tech stocks; near-term drag on S&P/ASX All Technology Index.

sectors.trend: Banks face headwinds from rising sovereign borrowing costs and softening mortgage demand despite recent resilience.
sectors.implications: Net interest margin compression risk; major banks (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX) face slowing credit growth.

sectors.trend: Woolworths gains market share at the expense of Coles, triggering significant valuation divergence.
sectors.implications: Relative outperformance for WOW.AX; heightened margin and volume risk for COL.AX.

sectors.trend: Australian home values decline for a seventh consecutive month alongside the weakest auction clearances since 2020.
sectors.implications: Asset devaluations and muted transaction activity create persistent valuation headwinds for REITs.

sectors.trend: Emerging domestic gas supply shortfall risks and delivery delays in major renewable and hydro infrastructure.
sectors.implications: Elevated wholesale energy prices support upstream gas producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX) while inflating industrial costs.

sectors.trend: Targeted speculative momentum in junior gold and critical minerals amid broader commodity caution.
sectors.implications: Selective upside in gold equities as defensive hedges; iron ore majors (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) sensitive to China and global rates.

key_themes: RBA interest rate overhang and persistent domestic inflationary pressures
Global equity contagion from Wall Street tech/AI pullback
Divergence in domestic retail staples (Woolworths taking share from Coles)
Deepening residential property downturn impacting household wealth and credit
Escalating government debt issuance elevating sovereign bond yields

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Persistent Inflation and Hawkish RBA Policy
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight rate-sensitive discretionary and tech sectors; prioritize cash preservation and defensive dividend yield.
Rotate out of high-beta tech equities into defensive staples and quality value names.
Reduce exposure to retail mortgage-heavy banks and property trusts exposed to residential developments.
Hedge duration risk in fixed income portfolios; favour balance-sheet-resilient corporates with minimal refinancing needs.

opportunities.recommendation: Long Woolworths vs Short Coles Pair Trade
opportunities.rationale: Woolworths is capturing market share and maintaining operational momentum while Coles faces revenue erosion.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate Quality Gold Producers as Safe-Haven Hedge
opportunities.rationale: Heightened global volatility, crypto turmoil, and rate uncertainty support gold miners as risk insurance.
Projected domestic supply constraints and potential regulatory interventions create price upside for producers.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Exposure to High-Beta ASX Technology Names
defensive_moves.rationale: Wall Street tech rout and AI skepticism threaten domestic tech multiples ahead of local rate decisions.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight Residential Mortgage Lenders and Leveraged REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Seven months of declining home values and weak auction clearances pressure loan books and asset values.

market_outlook.short_term: The ASX 200 (^AXJO) faces near-term downward pressure, weighed down by Wall Street's tech correction and pre-RBA risk aversion.
market_outlook.long_term: Subdued medium-term growth driven by restrictive monetary policy, elevated sovereign debt issuance, and prolonged housing market weakness.
key_catalysts: RBA Board interest rate decision and Governor statement
US midterm election results and implications for global trade and risk sentiment
Domestic wholesale gas policy updates and energy market interventions
Australian quarterly CPI and labor market reports
China macro indicators influencing iron ore demand
watch_list: CoreLogic daily home value index and weekend auction clearance rates
62% Fe iron ore CFR Qingdao and domestic spot gas prices
